description: Narrow the renewal guard so a cancelled subscription is allowed to renew
expected_violation: A cancelled subscription is renewed instead of rejected
violation_scenario: renew_subscription(Subscription(id='s1', status='cancelled', term_count=1)) increments term_count to 2 instead of raising.
rationale: Dropping 'cancelled' from the guarded statuses is the smallest change that permits renewing a cancelled subscription.
